The other: "O=S(=O)(O)c1ccccc1F" is a sulfonic acid with fluorobenzene. No nitro. So maybe the target molecule is something else.

Maybe the task chain: template_search-2 finds a template for nitro reduction. Then apply_template-2 should apply that template to the molecule (provided as input data). Actually reduction of nitro to amine would convert nitro to amine, not produce two separate molecules. So maybe the target is a molecule with nitro group that after reduction yields something else.
